1197.meaning1: black antelope hide cloak; deerskin cape
1197.commentary: (MNa) ajinan'ti ajinamigacammaṃ. ajinakkhipan'ti tadeva majjhe phālitaṃ. sakhurakanti'pi vadanti.

examples.text: so sāṇāni'pi dhāreti masāṇāni'pi dhāreti chavadussāni'pi dhāreti paṃsukūlāni'pi dhāreti tirīṭāni'pi dhāreti ajinam'pi dhāreti ajinakkhipam'pi dhāreti kusacīram'pi dhāreti vākacīram'pi dhāreti phalakacīram'pi dhāreti kesakambalam'pi dhāreti vāḷakambalam'pi dhāreti ulūkapakkham'pi dhāreti

1198.meaning1: wearing a black antelope hide cloak; clothed in a deerskin cape
1198.commentary: (SNa) ajinakkhipanivattho'ti sakhuraṃ ajinacammaṃ ekaṃ nivattho ekaṃ pāruto.

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā brāhmaṇavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā mahantena jaṭ'aṇḍuvena ajinakkhipanivattho jiṇṇo gopānasivaṅko ghurughurupassāsī udumbaradaṇḍaṃ gahetvā yena te bhikkhū ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca
